content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Resubmission or records alone would not cure the authorization denial, while billing the patient would be premature because the payer appeal path remains available. A formal appeal supported by the strong clinical documentation and medical-necessity rationale is the only valid payer rework path.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
